item.description:
Simulator Manager 1.5.0

What's Changed

Features

  • Copy container content: UserDefaults as JSON and folder paths by @Heckscheibe in https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/pull/68
    Every app, app group and device menu gains a Copy Path submenu that copies container folder paths to the clipboard, with spaces escaped so they paste cleanly into a terminal. Apps and app groups with UserDefaults also get Copy UserDefaults as JSON, for all domains at once or any single domain. Errors are reported instead of overwriting your clipboard.
  • Standalone MCP server for local coding agents by @Heckscheibe in https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/pull/103
    A new standalone MCP server, simple-simulator-mcp, lets local coding agents such as Claude Code, VS Code Copilot, Codex and Cursor query your simulators, installed apps, containers, recent installs and cleanup candidates. Reading UserDefaults and destructive actions are only available when you opt in with launch flags.
  • Ship the MCP server with the app and add agent setup to Preferences by @Heckscheibe in https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/pull/104
    The MCP server now ships inside the app, and Preferences has a new Agent Integration (MCP) section. It offers ready-to-paste setup snippets for Claude Code, VS Code (GitHub Copilot), Codex and generic mcpServers clients, with toggles for the opt-in features.
  • Add a searchable SwiftUI panel alongside the native menu by @Heckscheibe in https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/pull/83
    The menu bar menu is now a searchable panel that you can filter by typing. Search matches app names, bundle identifiers, device names and OS versions, ranking recent apps first.
  • Add keyboard navigation to the menu bar panel by @Heckscheibe in https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/pull/84
    The menu bar panel can be driven entirely from the keyboard. Use the arrow keys to move and enter or leave submenus, ↩ to activate, and ⌘↩ or ⌥↩ for secondary actions. Destructive rows such as erasing a simulator need a second ↩ to confirm.
  • Add type-to-filter search to the menu bar panel by @Heckscheibe in https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/pull/85
    The panel opens with its search field focused, so you can start typing to filter devices and apps right away. The top hit is preselected so ↩ opens it, and esc clears the query before closing the panel.
  • Save an app snapshot to a folder from the menu bar panel by @Heckscheibe in https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/pull/114
    Every app in the panel gains Save Snapshot to Folder…, which saves the app's container data to a named folder in ~/Downloads or a folder you choose in Preferences. The row shows progress while saving, and Finder opens on the result when it finishes.
  • Snapshot only databases and/or UserDefaults by @Heckscheibe in https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/pull/117
    Snapshots can now be limited to databases (SQLite and Realm), UserDefaults, or both, in addition to everything. Choose the option from the Save Snapshot to Folder submenu.
  • Add snapshot tools to the MCP server by @Heckscheibe in https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/pull/118
    The MCP server can now capture, diff, restore and delete app snapshots, so agents can repeatedly test things like database migrations from the same starting data. These tools are off unless you turn on the new Allow app snapshots toggle in Preferences.
  • Add a setting to hide UI test runner apps (#88) by @Heckscheibe in https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/pull/119
    A new setting hides UI test runner apps from each device's apps, Recent Apps and search. They are hidden by default, and you can toggle this from the menu or the settings window.
  • Cleanup: show what was checked, and offer stale simulator runtimes for removal by @Heckscheibe in https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/pull/128
    A new Cleanup Runtimes submenu offers stale simulator runtimes for removal: unusable, superseded by a newer build, or unused for 90 days. Deletion is always confirmed and shows the space freed. The simulator cleanup also reports how many simulators it checked when nothing needs removing.
  • Show install/update age per app and flag stale installs by @Heckscheibe in https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/pull/121
    App rows now show how long ago each app was installed or updated, and installs older than a threshold are flagged as stale. You can turn this off and set the stale threshold (7 days by default) in Preferences.
  • In-app auto-updater via Sparkle (signed appcast, self-install, relaunch) by @Heckscheibe in https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/pull/129
    The app now updates itself using Sparkle: it checks a signed feed, shows release notes, downloads, installs and relaunches. Use Check for Updates… in the menu, or switch automatic checks on or off in Settings.

Improvements

  • Polish the menu bar panel: empty state, accessibility, scale by @Heckscheibe in https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/pull/86
    The panel shows a clear empty state when a search has no matches and keeps a steady height while you type. VoiceOver support is improved with better row labels, announced result counts and spoken destructive confirmations.
  • Open panel submenus as hover flyouts by @Heckscheibe in https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/pull/93
    Submenus in the panel now open as flyouts beside the panel, like a native menu, instead of replacing the current view. Moving the pointer diagonally into a flyout no longer closes it by accident.
  • Hand-tune the app icon's dark and clear appearances by @Heckscheibe in https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/pull/144
    The app icon has refined Dark, Clear and Tinted appearances, with a near-black background in Dark mode and clearer layering of the device outlines in Clear and Tinted.

Bugfixes

  • Open the menu bar panel through an expanded interface session on macOS 27 by @Heckscheibe in https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/pull/127
    Fixes the global shortcut and the menu bar panel not opening or closing correctly on macOS 27.
  • Publish the Sparkle appcast on develop instead of a nonexistent main by @Heckscheibe in https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/pull/131
    Fixes Check for Updates failing with a 404 error by pointing the app at the correct update feed.
  • Address findings from the whole-app code review (#132) by @Heckscheibe in https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/pull/133
    Fixes several issues found in a full review. Apps from an erased simulator no longer linger in Recent Apps, and app groups are matched to their apps more accurately. Cleanup lists stay correct after a failed rescan, and the menu shows "Loading simulators…" at launch instead of blocking. Simulator commands that hang now time out.
  • Notice the first app install on a busy, freshly erased simulator by @Heckscheibe in https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/pull/135
    Fixes a delay of a minute or more before the first app installed on a freshly erased, running simulator appeared in the menu. It now shows up within a few seconds.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/Heckscheibe/SimpleSimulatorManager/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0
